macro_pipeline: Hardware Touch -> IOHIDEventSystem -> backboardd -> BKSTouchStream -> UIScrollViewPanGestureRecognizer -> Drag ContentOffset Update -> Release Velocity Estimation -> _UIScrollViewDecelerationAnimation -> CADisplayLink (120Hz ProMotion) -> CATransaction Commit -> GPU Framebuffer Presentation

phase_1_input_and_gesture.trigger: User finger establishes physical contact with capacitive touch screen.

steps.operation: Capacitive touch digitizer generates raw hardware interrupt. Digitizer packet is timestamped and translated to IOHIDEvent digitizer event.
Calculates pointer scroll acceleration curve and applies friction scale filter to raw touch report.
backboardd validates process entitlement, performs display orientation translation, and packages touch into BKSTouchStream IPC message.
Main run loop drains Mach port, wraps message into UIEvent (type: UITouchEventTypeDirect), and routes to key UIWindow.
Performs recursive hit-testing (-[UIView hitTest:withEvent:]) to identify target view hierarchy containing UIScrollView.
Stores initial touch location, initializes velocity sample ring buffer, and schedules touch delay timer (UIScrollViewDelayedTouchesBeganGestureRecognizer).
Calculates cumulative euclidean displacement. When displacement exceeds touchSlop (typically 10.0 points), cancels subview touch delivery and transitions state machine from Possible to Began.

phase_2_drag_and_tracking.trigger: Pan gesture enters Began / Changed state as finger translates across viewport.

steps.operation: Mutates _scrollViewFlags.isDragging = 1. Inspects delegate flags; if respondsToSelector(scrollViewWillBeginDragging:), dispatches delegate callback.
Queries translation in viewport coordinates via -[UIPanGestureRecognizer translationInView:]. Computes candidate delta offset (dx, dy).
Evaluates edge boundary conditions. If candidate offset overshoots content bounds and bounces == YES, applies non-linear rubber-band resistance curve: x = (d * c * d_max) / (d_max + c * d).
Assigns new content offset point to ivar _contentOffset (+0x100). Invokes internal routine -[UIScrollView _setContentOffset:animated:animation:notify:].
Mutates CALayer bounds origin (layer.bounds.origin = contentOffset). Triggers CoreGraphics layout pass and updates scroll indicators.
Inspects _scrollViewFlags.delegateScrollViewDidScroll; dispatches -[id<UIScrollViewDelegate> scrollViewDidScroll:] and informs _UIScrollViewScrollObserver.
Transitions gesture state machine from Changed to Ended. Evaluates release velocity vector using -[UIPanGestureRecognizer velocityInView:].
Computes projected ballistic rest position: s_proj = v0 / (-ln(d)). Dispatches -[id<UIScrollViewDelegate> scrollViewWillEndDragging:withVelocity:targetContentOffset:].
Mutates _scrollViewFlags.isDragging = 0. Dispatches -[id<UIScrollViewDelegate> scrollViewDidEndDragging:willDecelerate:].
If velocity exceeds threshold (10.0 pt/s) and not at rest, mutates _scrollViewFlags.isDecelerating = 1. Dispatches -[id<UIScrollViewDelegate> scrollViewWillBeginDecelerating:].
Instantiates deceleration animation controller. Sets initial kinetic velocity (v0) and selects deceleration rate: Normal (0.998) or Fast (0.990).
If release occurred within rubber-band zone or projected path overshoots boundary, engages damped harmonic oscillator spring return.

governing_equations.velocity_decay: v(t) = v0 * (d ^ t) = v0 * exp(-lambda * t)

phase_4_compositor_and_render.trigger: CADisplayLink VSYNC timer tick fires on main thread.

steps.operation: Boosts ProMotion display refresh to CAFrameRateRange(min: 80Hz, max: 120Hz, preferred: 120Hz) during dynamic deceleration.
Evaluates elapsed dt since last tick. Integrates current velocity: delta_pos = (v_current * (1 - d^dt)) / (-ln(d)). Updates current offset.
Compares instantaneous speed |v(t)| against stop velocity threshold (0.1 pt/s). If below threshold, stops animation timer.
Mutates _scrollViewFlags.isDecelerating = 0. Invalidate CADisplayLink. Resets CAFrameRateRange to standard idle rate (10Hz-60Hz).
Inspects _scrollViewFlags.delegateScrollViewDidEndDecelerating; dispatches -[id<UIScrollViewDelegate> scrollViewDidEndDecelerating:].
Packages modified layer bounds tree into render server IPC payload, serialized via shared memory to backboardd render engine.
GPU Metal command encoder executes tiled fragment shading, presenting frame to display controller on hardware VBLANK.
